name: Meta Sturgeon County AI-optimized Data Center
notes: Meta says it broke ground on its first Canadian data center in Sturgeon County, Alberta; 1 GW, more than CAD 13B investment, closed-loop liquid cooling, not yet operational.

name: Wonder Valley AI Data Centre Park Phase 1
notes: Alberta Major Projects lists a proposed Phase 1 in Greenview No. 16 near Grande Prairie with a 1.4 GW off-grid power system; estimated cost CAD 12B and full buildout investment cited as CAD 70B.

name: eStruxture CAL-3 Data Centre
notes: eStruxture announced a CAD 750M hyperscale AI-focused facility five kilometres north of Calgary in Rocky View County, designed for 90 MW, with operation expected by end-2026.

name: AWS Canada West (Calgary) Region
notes: AWS launched the Canada West (Calgary) Region with three Availability Zones; AWS does not disclose individual facility locations or MW capacity.

name: Jet.AI / StratGrid Project Wheatland
notes: Jet.AI lists an Alberta project in Wheatland County, Southern Alberta, with several hundred acres controlled by StratGrid and approximately 200 MW of behind-the-meter natural gas generation capacity.

name: Equinix Calgary IBX facilities
notes: Equinix's Canada location page lists Calgary as a Canadian market with three data centers; individual Calgary site capacities were not disclosed on the source page.

name: Qu Data Centres Alberta facilities
notes: Qu Data Centres operates former Rogers data-center assets across Calgary and Edmonton as part of a nine-facility Ontario/Alberta platform; platform capacity is 49 MW but per-province capacity was not disclosed.

name: eStruxture VAN-1 Vancouver Data Center
notes: Operator page identifies VAN-1 at 55 East 7th Avenue in Vancouver with total capacity of 2.4 MW and high-density colocation services.

name: eStruxture VAN-2 Vancouver Data Center
notes: Operator page identifies VAN-2 in downtown Vancouver at 555 West Hastings Street with total capacity of 2.14 MW.

name: eStruxture VAN-3 Burnaby Data Center
notes: Operator page identifies VAN-3 in Burnaby near BCIT and the Trans-Canada Highway; listed total capacity is 13 MW and the site supports AI/HPC densities.

name: Equinix KA1 Kamloops IBX Data Center
notes: Equinix lists KA1 at 1460 Bunker Road, Kamloops; DataCenterMap reports 6 MVA critical power and more than 44,000 sq ft white space, but MW IT load was not disclosed by Equinix.

name: Equinix Vancouver IBX Data Center
notes: Equinix lists one Vancouver data center market serving Western Canada, the U.S. Pacific Northwest, and Asia-Pacific routes; capacity not disclosed.

name: Nanaimo East Wellington Road Data Center
notes: City of Nanaimo statement confirms public interest around the proposed data centre at 2090 East Wellington Road; DCD reports a two-story 18,000 sq m facility in 10 modular phases. MW not disclosed.

name: TELUS / Westbank proposed British Columbia AI data centres
notes: ConstructConnect reports TELUS is working with the Canadian government and Westbank on three proposed AI data centres in B.C.; one would expand an existing Kamloops centre and two would be new Vancouver facilities. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Jet.AI / Consensus Core Manitoba AI Data Center Campus
notes: Jet.AI lists a site roughly ten miles south of Winnipeg on about 350 acres with multi-hundred-MW potential using grid power plus natural gas; DCD locates the site near Ile-des-Chenes. Exact capacity not disclosed by operator.

name: Equinix WI1 Winnipeg IBX Data Center
notes: Equinix lists WI1 at 1450 Waverley Street in Winnipeg with 25,005 sq ft of space; property owner materials describe a 64,000 sq ft Tier III design-certified purpose-built facility constructed in 2015.

name: Spruce Lake AI Hub / Saint John AI Data Centre
notes: Project website says Beacon Data Centers and VoltaGrid are partnering on the Spruce Lake AI Hub near Saint John; the data center requires up to 400 MW at full capacity, with grid supply capped at 210 MW and VoltaGrid providing up to 190 MW. Local reporting notes opposition and EIA scrutiny.

name: Equinix SJ1 Saint John Data Center
notes: Equinix lists Saint John as a Canadian market with one data center; the site came from the 2020 Bell Canada data-center portfolio acquisition. Capacity not disclosed.

name: BlockLab Goose Bay Data Center
notes: North Star Associates says its client BlockLab operates data processing facilities using Labrador climate and hydroelectric generation, including a 6 MW Goose Bay site; CER separately noted operating Labrador crypto/data centres and large pending load applications.

name: BlockLab Wabush Data Center
notes: North Star Associates describes engineering, construction management, and commissioning for BlockLab's 20 MW Wabush data processing site.

name: Labrador data centre load applications
notes: Canada Energy Regulator reported Labrador had eleven operating crypto-capable data centres using about 17 MW, with remaining applications waiting for service totaling about 326 MW. Applicants and current status were not named in the public snapshot.

name: Crypto Boreas Happy Valley-Goose Bay data center applications
notes: DCD reported Happy Valley-Goose Bay denied two data-center applications and previously shut down a Crypto Boreas bitcoin mining facility for operating without necessary permits.

name: IceFox Data Center
notes: KatloTech describes an Indigenous-led hydro-powered modular IceFox data center campus on Treaty 8 land near K'atl'odeeche First Nation / Hay River, targeting commercial launch in 2028; DCD reports 20,500 sq ft across containerized buildings. MW not consistently disclosed.

name: Jet.AI Maritime Canada Data Center
notes: Jet.AI lists a Canadian Maritimes project expected to support approximately 500 MW, with details forthcoming in 2026; Baxtel places the Maritime Canada site in Nova Scotia and lists planned timing around 2027-2028. Exact municipality not publicly disclosed.

name: Eastlink Pennant Point Data Centre
notes: Eastlink offers colocation services at its Pennant Point Data Centre near Halifax/Sambro with dual UPS, dual generators, and communications-grade environmental controls; capacity not disclosed.

name: Rogers Halifax HAL DC1
notes: Baxtel lists Rogers Halifax HAL DC1 as an operational carrier data center in Halifax; Bell's 2020 transaction release also notes Bell retained data centres in network central offices including Halifax.

name: Microsoft Vaughan Datacentre
notes: Microsoft says first-phase Vaughan construction began May 8, 2024; building construction completed July 2, 2026, with equipment installation, testing, and preparation through early 2028. Site not yet operational.

name: Microsoft Markham Datacentre
notes: Microsoft says Markham first-phase development began in May 2024 with site preparation; data centre building construction is expected to begin in late 2026 after site preparation and foundation work.

name: Microsoft Etobicoke Datacentre
notes: Microsoft says construction of the Etobicoke data centre in Toronto began November 21, 2024; building completion is expected in fall 2026 with preparation through fall 2027, and the site is not yet operational.

name: Serverfarm TOR1 Toronto Data Center
notes: Serverfarm says TOR1 is an AI-ready Toronto data center; DCD reports a 14 MW expansion brought utility power availability to more than 21 MW.

name: Serverfarm TOR2.1 Data Center
notes: Turner Construction describes the Serverfarm TOR2.1 project as a two-story facility with total critical load of 8 MW and a 4 MW data hall build-out.

name: Equinix Toronto IBX facilities
notes: Equinix lists seven Toronto-area data centers serving the Toronto market, including TR1, TR2, TR4, TR5, TR6, and TR7 references on its Toronto page. Capacity not disclosed per site.

name: Equinix Ottawa OT1 Data Center
notes: Equinix lists OT1 as serving the core Ottawa market with high-security access for government and blue-chip customers; third-party listings place the facility in Gatineau, QC for the Ottawa market. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Qu Data Centres Ontario facilities
notes: Qu Data Centres operates facilities in Ottawa, Toronto, and London, Ontario as part of a nine-facility Ontario/Alberta platform with 49 MW total capacity and 187,840 sq ft of IT white space; per-site MW not disclosed.

name: Digital Realty Toronto data centers
notes: Digital Realty's Toronto data-center page confirms operating Toronto data centers for colocation and PlatformDIGITAL services; individual site count and MW not disclosed in accessible source text.

name: Atlantic Technology Centre Colocation Data Centre
notes: Atlantic Technology Centre in Charlottetown operates a 2,500 sq ft environmentally controlled colocation data centre with N+1 cooling, raised floor, monitoring, and fire suppression. No hyperscale proposal found for PEI.
